en: Black-and-white photograph showing a European riverside cityscape. In the foreground is the steep roof and spire of a Gothic-style church or chapel next to a quay with stacked timber, a horse-drawn vehicle, and a small riverside structure. Across the wide river stands a dense cluster of late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century multi‑storey residential and institutional buildings on a gentle hill. On the far bank's embankment, large white letters are laid out on the slope facing the water. At the bottom edge of the image there is handwritten text on the negative.
